title: Create: some pressing crafts
description: A datapack that adds 2 pressing crafts
body:
This datapack for the Create mod adds 2 press recipes
– Crafting diamonds from coal
– Crafting netherite from netherrack
To use the datapack, you need to download and unpack the ZIP archive, then place all its contents into one folder, and finally put that folder into the minecraft\saves\YourWorld\datapacks directory
